text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "By default Redis writes snapshots to a binary file called dump.rdb",
      "claim_text": "By default Redis saves snapshots to a binary file called dump.rdb.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P0.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "you can also take a snapshot manually with SAVE or BGSAVE",
      "claim_text": "You can manually take a snapshot with SAVE or BGSAVE.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "manually call the `SAVE` or `BGSAVE` commands"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P0.S1 states manual SAVE/BGSAVE."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "SAVE blocks the server while it runs",
      "claim_text": "SAVE blocks the server while it runs.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passages do not mention SAVE blocking."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "BGSAVE does the work in a forked background child",
      "claim_text": "BGSAVE does the work in a forked background child.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passages do not describe BGSAVE forking."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Redis 2.4 and later will not start an AOF rewrite while an RDB snapshot is in progress",
      "claim_text": "Redis 2.4 and later avoids triggering an AOF rewrite when an RDB snapshot is in progress.",
      "kind": "version",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": {"kind": "version", "left": "2.4", "op": ">=", "right": "2.4"},
      "reasoning": "P5.S0 states Redis >= 2.4 behavior."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "if you call BGREWRITEAOF during a snapshot the command fails with an error",
      "claim_text": "Calling BGREWRITEAOF during a snapshot fails with an error.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P6.S0 says it replies OK and schedules, not error."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "you have to retry it once the snapshot finishes",
      "claim_text": "You have to retry BGREWRITEAOF once the snapshot finishes.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P6.S0 says rewrite starts automatically after snapshot."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "When both AOF and RDB are enabled, Redis loads the RDB file on restart",
      "claim_text": "When both AOF and RDB are enabled, Redis loads the RDB file on restart.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S0", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P7.S0 says AOF file is used, not RDB."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "RDB files can be copied safely while Redis is running",
      "claim_text": "RDB files can be copied safely while Redis is running.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P8.S0 states backup friendly copying while running."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a new snapshot is written under a temporary name and atomically renamed with rename(2) once it is complete",
      "claim_text": "A new snapshot is written under a temporary name and atomically renamed with rename(2) once complete.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P8.S0 describes temporary name and atomic rename."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "The rdbcompression option is on by default and compresses string objects with LZF",
      "claim_text": "The rdbcompression option is on by default and compresses string objects with LZF.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passages do not mention rdbcompression or LZF."
    }
  ]
}
